description: The file defines an internal partial class 'AdoNetQueueAdapterReceiver' that implements 'IQueueAdapterReceiver' for receiving message batches from an ADO.NET provider queue. It handles initialization, shutdown, message retrieval, message confirmation, and logging, specifically for interacting with relational storage for streaming messages.

classes.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterReceiver
classes.description: An internal class that acts as a receiver for message batches from an ADO.NET provider in Orleans streaming, managing message retrieval, confirmation, and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the receiver, waiting for any outstanding storage operations to complete, with exception handling and logging.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of messages from the queue, converting storage messages into batch containers, with logic to prevent retrieval after shutdown.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Confirms message processing completion by executing confirmation asynchronously, with error logging for failures.
